The Role

What is a Forex Affiliate Program?

A forex affiliate program pays you for sending traders to a broker. You promote TMGM through your own channels —
a website, a review site, a newsletter, paid ads, a social following — and when someone you referred opens an account
and starts trading, you get paid.

Media buying is unforgiving — you pay for the click whether or not anything comes of it. So the questions that matter are whether the traffic converts, and whether you get credited for it.

Affiliate programs pay in one of three ways: CPA, a one-time commission when a referred client qualifies; revenue share, an ongoing cut of what they trade; or a hybrid of the two. TMGM pays CPA — up to US$600 per qualified client, tiered by the region your traffic comes from, the source it arrives through and the quality of the clients it produces, and agreed with your partnership manager. What matters more than the headline is how many of your referrals actually qualify.

Affiliate Program FAQ

A forex affiliate program pays you for sending traders to a broker. You promote TMGM through your own channels — a website, a review site, a newsletter, paid ads or a social following — and when someone you referred opens an account and starts trading, you get paid. The affiliate supplies the audience; the broker supplies the product, the platform and the payouts.

Apply online using the form on this page. It takes about five minutes and there is nothing to pay. Applications are subject to approval. A partnership manager reviews your application and gets in touch, and once you are approved you receive your unique affiliate link along with access to the creative library and your partner portal.

TMGM's affiliate program pays CPA — a one-time commission for each referred client who qualifies, up to US$600 per client, rather than a share of what they trade afterwards. Rates are tiered rather than flat and are agreed with your partnership manager, reflecting the region your traffic comes from, the source it arrives through and the quality of the clients it produces.

Every click on your link, every registration and every funded account appears in your partner portal, attributed to you and close to real time. You can see which placements are working and reconcile what you spent against what you earned, rather than waiting on a monthly statement.

Tiered commissions agreed with a named manager rather than a fixed rate card; attribution you can verify yourself in the partner portal; a creative library of banners, landing pages and campaign content in several languages; a broker regulated across four jurisdictions that your audience can check; and VIP access to exclusive events including Chelsea FC match experiences.

You need an audience and a way to reach it — a website, a review site, a newsletter, paid campaigns or a social following. Applications are subject to approval. Affiliates are expected to promote responsibly and to follow the advertising and regulatory requirements that apply in the markets they target.

Banners and display creative in standard sizes, landing pages you can send traffic straight to, and campaign content you can adapt for your own audience — available in several languages so you are not translating our material before you can use it. If you need something the library does not have, your partnership manager can brief it.

Yes. TMGM offers Islamic swap-free accounts for clients who require them, alongside our Edge, Classic and Cent account types. There are no overnight swap charges, with the same spreads and execution. Your partnership manager can confirm availability for your clients' region when you join.

Nothing. Applying is free and there is no obligation. Applications are subject to approval. You earn from the first referred client who qualifies.

Affiliates reach audiences online through traffic, content, advertising and followers, and the relationship with the trader is usually brief — they arrive through your link and become TMGM's client. Introducing Brokers work through relationships they already have, often locally, and tend to stay involved with the clients they introduce, earning on trading volume rather than a one-time commission. If you run a site, a channel or paid campaigns, the affiliate program is the better fit.
